lessons.description: Learn to describe where things are
objectives: Use prepositions: in, on, under, next to, between
language_focus: The book is on the desk.
The cat is under the table.

activities.title: Prepositions
activities.instruction: Learn words that describe WHERE something is.

items.definition: Inside something. The ball is IN the box.
On top of something. The book is ON the table.
Below something. The cat is UNDER the bed.
Beside something. The shop is NEXT TO the bank.
In the middle of two things. The bank is BETWEEN the shop and the school.
Facing something, on the other side. The mosque is OPPOSITE the school.

content.feedback: Well done! You have mastered these new words. 🏮

content.transcript: Kim: Hello. Do you speak English? Fatma: Yes, I do. Kim: Oh, good. Where’s the bakery, please? I want to buy some bread. Fatma: It’s over there, behind the Post Ofﬁce. Kim: Thank you. Oh, my name’s Kim. I’m from England. Fatma: And I’m Fatma. Nice to meet you. Kim, do you want to come to my house some time? Kim: Oh, yes, please. When can I come? Fatma: On Friday. Kim: What time? Fatma: Four o’clock. Kim: Four o’clock. OK. Fatma: Good. You can tell me all about England and your family. Kim: See you on Friday at four. Oh, Fatma, where do you live? Fatma: I live in that block of ﬂats over there, behind the supermarket. My ﬂat’s on the sixth ﬂoor.

items.example: My grandfather likes to read in his armchair.
items.definition: A large, comfortable chair with side supports for a person's arms.

items.example: We all sat on the sofa to watch the movie.
items.definition: A long upholstered seat with a back and arms, for two or more people.

items.example: We can hear the call to prayer from the mosque.
items.definition: A building used for public worship by Muslims.

items.example: They live in a flat on the third floor.
items.definition: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a larger building.

items.example: The sofa has many colourful cushions.
items.definition: Pillows or pads stuffed with soft material, used for sitting or leaning on.

items.example: The cat is sleeping on the carpet.
items.definition: A thick, soft covering for a floor.

items.example: I bought a new story from the bookshop.
items.definition: A shop where books are sold.

items.example: Please put the book back on the shelf.
items.definition: A flat length of wood or other rigid material, attached to a wall or forming part of a piece of furniture, used to hold things.

items.example: I need to go to the post office to mail this letter.
items.definition: A place where you can buy stamps and send letters and parcels.

items.example: The bakery smells wonderful in the morning.
items.definition: A place where bread and cakes are made and sold.

items.example: I turned on the lamp to read my book.
items.definition: A device for giving light.

items.example: The doctor works at the big hospital.
items.definition: A place where sick or injured people are given medical care.

items.example: He played his favourite music on the stereo.
items.definition: A machine for playing music.

items.example: Please close the curtains; the sun is too bright.
items.definition: Pieces of cloth hung to cover a window.

items.example: We are going to a restaurant for dinner tonight.
items.definition: A place where people pay to sit and eat meals that are cooked and served on the premises.

items.example: There is a beautiful picture of a horse on the wall.
items.definition: A painting, drawing, or photograph of someone or something.

items.example: I need to go to the bank to get some cash.
items.definition: A place where people can keep their money.

items.example: The police officer works at the police station.
items.definition: The office of a local police force.
